input.title: Hackathon radar · Tue Oct 27
input.content:
# Hackathon radar · Tue Oct 27

**Three things changed since yesterday.** All names, counts and dates here are example data from fixtures, not real events.

- **Rules:** the example rules page now requires a public repository with a visible open-source licence. Ours has one; the licence file must stay at the repo root.
- **Pace:** 3 new submissions in the Personal AI track (example data); the deadline is Nov 15, 10:00 UTC.
- **Competitor:** Example Project A (Personal AI track) is a chat agent that drafts actions for approval: the same approval idea, one chat app, no crew, no learning.

## Who else is building a personal agent

| project | track | what it does | overlap with Nimbus |
|---|---|---|---|
| Example Project A | Personal AI | chat agent that asks before each action | approvals only |
| Example Project B | Apps & Agents | shared to-do lists | none |
| Example Project C | Apps & Agents | recurring reminders | none |

## Say differently

Lead with the crew and the learning loop, not "an agent with approvals": approvals are table stakes now.

*Source news (example): cached input is billed at a lower rate; our role prompts are a stable prefix for exactly this.*
